spec.description: GPS constellation monitoring for raspberrypi-ntp — satellite signal strength, DOP, fix status, and sky coverage

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_sky" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "nSat")
  |> last()

spec.title: Satellite Elevation (°)
spec.description: Higher elevation = stronger signal and less atmospheric distortion. Solid lines = used in fix; dashed lines (----) = visible but not used.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_satellites" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.used == "1")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${used}" == "used" or "${used}" == "both")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "el")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_satellites" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.used == "0")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => "${used}" == "unused" or "${used}" == "both")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "el")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Current Satellite Status
spec.description: Current snapshot of all visible satellites

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_satellites" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ss" or r._field == "el" or r._field == "az" or r._field == "used")
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["prn", "constellation", "_field"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["prn", "constellation"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with wiki_url: if r.constellation == "GPS" then "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_GPS_satellites" else if r.constellation == "GLONASS" then "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_GLONASS_satellites" else "https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GNSS"}))
  |> keep(columns: ["prn", "used", "constellation", "ss", "el", "az", "wiki_url"])
  |> sort(columns: ["ss"], desc: true)

spec.title: Fix Status
spec.description: Current GPS fix mode. 3D fix is required for reliable PPS timing discipline.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_tpv" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "mode")
  |> last()

spec.title: GPS Time Error Estimate (ept)
spec.description: gpsd's estimated timestamp error in seconds. A rising trend indicates degrading GPS time solution.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_tpv" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ept")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: CPU Temperature (°C)
spec.description: Raw cpu_temp values are millidegrees; this panel divides by 1000.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "cpu_temp" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with _value: r._value / 1000.0}))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value"])

spec.title: Altitude (MSL)
spec.description: GPS-derived altitude above mean sea level, in feet. Updates every minute from gpsd TPV message.

spec.query:

  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_tpv" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")

spec.title: Horiz. Position Error (eph)

spec.title: Satellites Visible (nSat) vs Used (uSat)
spec.description: nSat = satellites visible (signal detected); uSat = satellites actually used in the fix.

spec.query:
from(bucket: "ntp")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "gps_sky" and r.host == "raspberrypi-ntp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "nSat" or r._field == "uSat")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

spec.title: Signal Strength by Satellite (dB-Hz)
spec.description: Signal strength per satellite PRN. Higher = better lock. Solid lines = used in fix; dashed lines (----) = visible but not used.

spec.query:

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ss")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> timedMovingAverage(every: 1m, period: 5m)
